summary: BayFirst Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of a previously disclosed rights offering, following SEC effectiveness of its Form S-1 on August 31, 2026. The company is offering shareholders of record as of May 12, 2026 up to 4,108,072 common shares at $3.50 per share, part of a recapitalization. Final prospectus filed under Rule 424(b)(3). Regan Associates, Inc. serves as information agent. The offering is a subscription rights offering; shareholders receive rights to purchase shares pro rata, with potential over-subscription privileges. Watch for subscription period trading, take-up rate, and potential dilution or price pressure on BAFN shares.
